nodes.label: Blue Bowtie Hazard Marker Motif
nodes.rationale: Design pattern of the texture: a high-contrast blue (RGB ~37,151,213) hourglass/bowtie emblem formed by two triangles meeting at a center point, with a thick near-black outline on a white background, plus a small dark mark at the center waist. The high-contrast blue-on-white scheme is suited to standing out from grass/ground for drone camera detection. Part of a hazard-style texture family (sibling files hazard_danger.png, hazard_flammable.png in the same directory). AMBIGUOUS: the exact meaning of the small central mark could not be verified visually in this environment.

nodes.label: Health Delivery Zone Ground Marker
nodes.rationale: Semantic role inferred from the filename segment 'health' in the hazard_* texture set: the texture marks a health/medical-themed zone (e.g., a medical delivery drop zone) on the drone field. The visual interpretation (hazard-style ground marker vs. medical emblem) could not be confirmed visually, so this purpose is flagged AMBIGUOUS.
